column1: # InitGameWorld callees (28 Oct 2026). Containers share one pooled linked-list layout; roles inferred from callers.

column4: level constructor and .LVL reader: base object ctor 00401bc0 (vtable 00428bf8), reads 0xc header (room count, anim-bank count), allocates lists, loads anim banks with AnimBank_Load, reads each 0x28-byte room record and its 0x20-byte object records, builds objects through Level_CreateObject; Ghidra decompile is garbled by the 0x13xx-byte frame, re-read from asm before porting
base game object: vtable 00428000, flags +0x68 |= 6, +0x5e = 5, byte +0x5c = 0

factory: switch on kind (record +0x18) allocating the right object class (sizes 0x6c, 0x84, 0x78, 0x6c, 0x74, 0xd8 ... kind 5 has a sub-switch on record byte +5); adds objects of kind 1 to level +0x90
calls 0040f710 on the level's object list (+0x74), which calls 00401bf0(child, level) for every child
iterates list and calls 00401bf0(node object, arg)
forwards (x, y, duration) to the camera at +0x80
0x40-byte object at level +0x80; zeroes +0 and +0x10
stores 4 ints at +0x1c..+0x28; Level_Load passes (-320, 239, 319, -240)
duration 0: set position now (00402120); otherwise stores start/target and a start time from the game clock
pooled doubly-linked list header (0x1c bytes) with node storage of capacity*8+0x18 bytes, or a copy of another list
iterates to the last node and links a new node holding the pointer
removes the node holding the pointer
12-byte nodes (object, priority): inserts before the first node with a higher priority; main list uses priorities 0x13 (interface level), 100 (top object)
16-byte room record: +0 index, +4 a field from the file record +0x24, +8/+10 shorts, +0xc object list
inserts object into the room list ordered by object field +0x4c
0x2b0-byte table; entry count at +0x2ac set to 0
(archive offset, id): reads entries introduced by '.' bytes; each entry built by 00404810 and registered by kind
calls 00405630 for each entry
base object with vtable 0042be08, inserted with priority 100 (frontmost)
(archive offset): reads lines of the OBJETOS.TXT-style table and stores records of 16 bytes; first pass counts lines
DirectShow setup via CoCreateInstance, builds path c:\INSTALL\BIN\DATA\%02i.BIN; last call of InitGameWorld. Only the setup was read, what it plays and when is unconfirmed
